author: JohnEMcIntyre
author_role: John McIntyre, Principal Game Designer Supervisor, identified by the official HearthstoneTeam thread
statement: Locked is a condition that must be met in-play before the first activation. Once it is unlocked, it will function like a normal location for its remaining uses. The condition does not need to be met multiple times, and it has a two turn cooldown like any location between uses. You do not need to satisfy the requirement over multiple cards, so playing Uldir Quarantine then another Uldir Quarantine, will unlock the first one. It only starts tracking the requirement once in play.
